hints.title: Manhattan Dimension Decoupling
hints.text: The expression |arr1[i] - arr1[j]| + |arr2[i] - arr2[j]| + |i - j| can be unpacked into four linear sign combinations.

hints.title: Sign Permutations
hints.text: For each combination of signs (p, q) in {1, -1} x {1, -1}, project each index into value arr1[i] * p + arr2[i] * q + i.

hints.title: Extreme Span Evaluation
hints.text: For each sign assignment, the maximum difference is max(projected) minus min(projected). Take the overall maximum across the four configurations.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all pairs takes quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Mathematical projection into 4 1D coordinate systems computes the maximum span in linear time and constant space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize Manhattan distance expansion into independent linear components.
complexity.notes: Since |i - j| = i - j for i >= j, sign on index component is fixed without loss of generality.
